cases.name: layout sheet contains both actual renderer canvases
cancel writes no scene or journal changes
layout applies one editable change without durable source text
source change refuses stale layout without editing
frozen snapshot retains independent content and capture date
deleted-source follow refuses and preserves frozen snapshot
relink clears copied title and keeps card identity
offline shared link hides title and displays last successful check
reconnect recovers accessible source without changing card geometry

limitations: Real React controls and renderer using an explicit synthetic local backend. Native source authorization and owned-file snapshot checks are separate.
